values: 召唤一具被击败后可以自行恢复的会动的铠甲协助作战。
Laios summons a Living Armor that can self-regenerate after defeat to assist.

在身边召唤一具行动缓慢但具有无限生命值的会动的铠甲并交由剑助操纵。会动的铠甲有1000点能量，且其攻击会造成莱欧斯攻击力300% + 30%的伤害。会动的铠甲存在期间每秒扣除25点能量，并且当会动的铠甲承受原始伤害量超过施法者250% + 20%攻击比例的伤害时，会额外扣除100点能量。当能量耗尽后，会动的铠甲会原地解体，每秒恢复125点能量，直至能量回满后再次投入战斗。后续释放本技能时，将会立即为剑助恢复1000点能量，并使其在接下来的10秒内提高120 + 10点攻击速度并免疫控制效果。

Laios summons a slow-moving armor with infinite HP, controlled by Kensuke. This Living Armor starts with 1,000 Energy and deals damage equal to 300% + 30% of Laios' ATK. It loses 25 Energy per second while it exists. Whenever it takes base damage exceeding 250% + 20% of the caster's ATK, it loses an extra 100 Energy. At zero Energy, the armor crumbles on the spot but regains 125 Energy per second until its Energy is full again, and then it returns to combat. When casting this skill again, Laios recovers 1,000 Energy for Kensuke, grants it control immunity and increases its ATK SPD by 120 + 10 over the next 10s.
会动的铠甲的攻击伤害提高至莱欧斯攻击力的320% + 30%。
Increases the Living Armor's ATK to 320% + 30% of Laios' ATK.
会动的铠甲的攻击伤害提高至莱欧斯攻击力的340% + 30%。
Increases the Living Armor's ATK to 340% + 30% of Laios' ATK.
会动的铠甲的攻击伤害提高至莱欧斯攻击力的360% + 30%。
Increases the Living Armor's ATK to 360% + 30% of Laios' ATK.
会动的铠甲的攻击伤害提高至莱欧斯攻击力的380% + 30%。
Increases the Living Armor's ATK to 380% + 30% of Laios' ATK.
威吓前方一定范围内的敌人，使其陷入迷惑。
Laios intimidates enemies in a frontal area, confusing them.
展开手脚，让身体看起来更大，发出大喊进行威吓。使前方相邻3格内的敌人陷入迷惑，在此期间敌人无法进行行动，且护甲与魔抗降低44% + 5%，持续3秒。若目标为魔物（怪物阵营的角色），则迷惑效果会在技能结束之后额外持续4 + 1秒。

Laios spreads his limbs to appear larger and lets out an intimidating roar. Enemies within 3 adjacent tiles in front become confused, unable to move or act and suffer a 44% + 5% reduction in both Phys DEF and Magic DEF for 3s. If the targets are monsters, the confusion effect extends for an additional 4 + 1s after the skill ends.
敌人的护甲与魔抗降低的比例提高至46% + 5%。
Increases the Phys DEF and Magic DEF reduction to 46% + 5%.
敌人的护甲与魔抗降低的比例提高至48% + 5%。
Increases the Phys DEF and Magic DEF reduction to 48% + 5%.
敌人的护甲与魔抗降低的比例提高至50% + 5%。
Increases the Phys DEF and Magic DEF reduction to 50% + 5%.
从被击败的魔物身上收集食材，烹饪料理为友军提供增益。
Laios collects ingredients from defeated monsters to cook meals that grant buffs to allies.

作为被动效果时，每当一名敌方魔物（怪物阵营的角色）被击败，莱欧斯就会从其身上收集一种食材，立即为自身恢复250点能量与500% ATK生命值。
主动使用时，莱欧斯就地取材烹饪料理，为2格范围内所有其他友军恢复500% ATK生命值，并使受影响的所有友军提高20% + 5%攻击力，持续8 + 0.5秒。主动释放本技能时，莱欧斯每收集了一份食材，便会使料理随机提供一项下列的额外增益：提升40%护甲与魔抗、提高30点急速、每秒恢复100% ATK生命值。额外增益最多触发3次。若目标为玛露西尔，则本技能还会额外使其恢复300点能量。

Passive. Whenever an enemy monster is defeated, Laios collects an ingredient from it and instantly recovers 250 Energy and 500% ATK HP.
Laios uses the collected ingredients and cooks on the spot, recovering 500% ATK HP for allies within 2 tiles and increasing their ATK by 20% + 5% for 8 + 0.5s. When actively used, for each ingredient Laios has collected, the cooked meal randomly grants one of the following extra buffs:
Increases Phys DEF and Magic DEF by 40%, increases Haste by 30, or recovers 100% ATK HP per second. Extra buffs can be triggered up to 3 times. If Marcille receives the buff, she recovers an extra 300 Energy.
烹饪料理恢复的生命值提高至520% ATK。
Increases HP recovery amount from cooking to 520% ATK.
烹饪料理恢复的生命值提高至540% ATK。
Increases HP recovery amount from cooking to 540% ATK.
烹饪料理恢复的生命值提高至560% ATK。
Increases HP recovery amount from cooking to 560% ATK.
战斗中，莱欧斯提升12%攻击力。
Laios increases his ATK by 12% during battle.
战斗中，莱欧斯提升16%攻击力。
Laios increases his ATK by 16% during battle.
战斗中，莱欧斯提升20%攻击力。
Laios increases his ATK by 20% during battle.
战斗开始时分析场上魔物，使其可以掉落更多食材。
Laios analyzes monsters when a battle starts, making them drop more ingredients.
战斗开始时，若敌方有魔物（怪物阵营的角色），莱欧斯会取出《迷宫美食指南》对其进行分析，使其可以掉落更多食材。当每名魔物首次累计损失30%最大生命值时，将会提前掉落一份额外的食材。每名魔物最多只能通过这种方式掉落1份额外的食材。

When a battle starts, if there are any monsters among the enemies, Laios takes out his Dungeon Gourmet Guide and starts analyzing those monsters to make them drop more ingredients. Each monster will prematurely drop an extra ingredient the first time it loses 30% of its max HP. Each monster can only drop 1 extra ingredient this way.
莱欧斯对魔物（怪物阵营的角色）造成的伤害提高50%。
Increases the damage Laios deals to monsters (excluding heroes and their summoned units) by 50%.
每收集了一份魔物掉落的食材，莱欧斯自身的护甲与防御力永久提高25%，最高叠加3次。
Permanently increases Laios' Phys DEF and Magic DEF by 25% for each ingredient collected from monsters, up to 3 stacks.
莱欧斯对魔物（怪物阵营的角色）造成的伤害提高80%。
Increases the damage Laios deals to monsters (excluding heroes and their summoned units) by 80%.
收集食材后永久提高自身最大生命值。
Laios permanently increases his max HP after collecting ingredients.
莱欧斯每通过技能“迷宫美食家”收集了一份不同的食材，便会永久提高20%最大生命值。本效果最多触发3次。
Laios permanently increases his max HP by 20% each time he collects a different ingredient using Dungeon Gourmet. This effect can be triggered up to 3 times.
